brief:
Mahmoud Khalil has petitioned the US Supreme Court to hear his free speech case, according to Middle East Eye. If the court accepts the case, a ruling would carry far-reaching implications for noncitizen Palestine advocates facing legal pursuit.

The petition signals a potential test of constitutional protections for advocacy speech involving Palestine, with potential consequences extending beyond Khalil's individual circumstances to others in similar legal situations.

title: Palestinian advocate Khalil petitions Supreme Court on free speech rights
